snapshot: WHO Eastern Mediterranean Region. Rolling out universal health insurance governorate by governorate, and the first country to reach the WHO gold tier for hepatitis C elimination.

leadership.role: Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Health and Population
leadership.name: Khaled Abdel Ghaffar

agenda.title: Universal health insurance, second phase
agenda.text: Egypt is preparing a pilot launch of its universal health insurance system in Minya as part of the second phase. Minister Abdel Ghaffar held a readiness meeting, stressed sticking to the official timeline, and proposed a joint monitoring unit with the governorate and more involvement of university hospitals and the private sector. About 90% of Minya's facilities are targeted for national quality accreditation this year.

agenda.title: Hepatitis C elimination
agenda.text: Egypt reached the WHO gold tier for eliminating hepatitis C as a public health threat in October 2023, the first country to do so. On 5 May 2026 the minister said a WHO 2026 report reaffirms Egypt's position as a global model, after the 2018-2019 national campaign.

agenda.title: WHO cooperation strategy
agenda.text: In October 2025 Egypt and WHO signed the Country Cooperation Strategy for 2024 to 2028, with priorities in public health, health infrastructure modernisation and capacity for universal health coverage, aligned with Egypt Vision 2030.
